STERLING HOSPITAL - MULTISPECIALTY CENTER
DISCHARGE SUMMARY

Patient Name: Sunita Patel                 UHID: ST-90214
Age / Sex: 42 Yrs / Female                 DOA: 10/02/2024
Consultant: Dr. Arvind Joshi               DOD: 14/02/2024

CLINICAL SUMMARY
Patient presented with acute right lower quadrant abdominal pain, nausea, and low-grade fever of 2 days duration.

FINAL DIAGNOSIS
Acute Appendicitis with localized peritonitis.

TREATMENT GIVEN
Emergency Laparoscopic Appendectomy performed under general anesthesia on 10/02/2024. Post-operative recovery uneventful.

DISCHARGE ADVICE
Tab Cefixime 200 mg BD for 5 days.
Tab Paracetamol 650 mg SOS for pain.
Follow up in surgical OPD after 7 days for suture check.
